quests.name: A Winter's Wool
quests.lore: Tam Ockley has five sheep in the pen with a winter's wool on, and hands that have stopped closing on the shears.

quests.name: The Runaways
quests.lore: Somebody left the paddock gate unlatched overnight and three of the Stablemaster's horses bolted. They won't have gone far, and they won't come back on their own either.

quests.name: The Scriptorium Apprentice
quests.lore: The Wizard keeps a lectern in his tower and nobody to work it.

quests.name: The Names on the Stones
quests.lore: Halden's ledger and the crypt disagree about how many are buried under the hill. He wants the brass plates off the coffins to settle it.

quests.name: Someone's Been Digging
quests.lore: Halden Rooke sweeps the crypt step every third day and knows how the door sits. It is not sitting right.

quests.name: The Bell-Ringer
quests.lore: A bell that has not rung in Halden's lifetime rang on Tuesday, in a room he sealed thirty-one years ago.

quests.name: Imp Menace
quests.lore: Imps are stealing from the market stall. Help us by defeating them.

quests.name: The Quiet Rows
quests.lore: Bandits have been skimming the north orchard for three weeks, never enough to bring the constable, always enough to notice. Jack Appleseed wants it answered with steel.

quests.name: Silver in the Deep
quests.lore: The tally book led to a silver seam at the bottom of the bandit cave, and to a name Constable Fenn has carried on his list for four years: Cull Marrow.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: It's out of my hands now.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That's what I wanted, and it still sits badly.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Three weeks that book was under the floor of the press house. Every day I did nothing with it, I was deciding something.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: You decided today.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I did. Whatever happens next down in that cave, it starts here.

quests.name: What Jill Knows
quests.lore: Jill Appleseed doesn't think the bandits taking exactly enough not to be noticed is luck. She thinks it's bookkeeping, and she wants the book.

quests.name: Help the Mining Trainer
quests.lore: Bring me 20 Iron Ore

quests.name: Downwind of Mossreach
quests.lore: Ossa Penhallow has watched Mossreach Swamp creep forty paces past her old cutting beds in three years, and she thinks the harpies on Gregor's road and the moving bog are the same story.

quests.name: Pirates' Treasure
quests.lore: Pirates down the coast from Plymouth robbed the wharf of the gold its fishermen had pooled. James Hookman wants them taught a lesson.

quests.name: Cargo for the Isle
quests.lore: The supplies bound for Ogre Isle never got there. Ogres holed up east of Underleaf took them off the road.

stages.text: Saw 10 pine planks at the sawmill in Hollis Tamber's yard at Plymouth Wharf and bring them to him.

objectives.text: Saw 10 pine planks at the sawmill in Hollis Tamber's yard at Plymouth Wharf and bring them to him.

stages.text: Hammer out 5 sets of iron fittings at the anvil in Hollis Tamber's yard and bring them to him.

objectives.text: Hammer out 5 sets of iron fittings at the anvil in Hollis Tamber's yard and bring them to him.

stages.text: Speak with Hollis Tamber at Plymouth Wharf.

objectives.text: Speak with Hollis Tamber at Plymouth Wharf.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Here's a saw and twenty pine logs. Hold the saw in your off hand and run the logs through the sawmill, two to a plank. I want ten. The hammer and the ore are for later.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Straight enough. Now the ironwork. Take the hammer to that ore at the anvil, one ore to a set, and bring me five sets of fittings.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Good. You'll want a lot more of both before you build anything of your own.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That's the trade. Planks at the sawmill, fittings at the anvil. The finer woods and metals come with practice.

quests.name: The Carpenter's Trade
quests.lore: Hollis Tamber patches every boat that ties up at Plymouth Wharf, and he has more hulls than hours.
quests.completionMessage: That's the trade. Planks at the sawmill, fittings at the anvil. The finer woods and metals come with practice.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Word travels fast out there. They knew before you did, probably.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Robbing his own kin. That is what it took to earn that name with them.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Get down to the dock. You've earned the crossing.

quests.name: The Ogre Traitor
quests.lore: The shipment was meant for the Ogres on Ogre Isle and one of their own took it. They call him the Traitor for that, and they want him dead before anything else crosses.
quests.completionMessage: The water's quiet for the first time in years. Dock's this way.

quests.name: The Broken Hammers
quests.lore: Hester Bell's tools are turning up in Rustpick with their handles broken. The goblins have a use for the iron and no use for the smith who made it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: These will do. The shafts we can replace ourselves.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: They'll come for the next cart.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Varruk will. He leads their raids from the southwest edge of that same camp. Deal with him before I put another patrol on the road.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I'll send the patrol out before dusk. They'll be glad of their kit.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: This spear's yours. Put your rear hand here and face me.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: You're well out of reach.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Of your sword, yes. Take half a step. There. That's where you want the other fellow when he starts his swing.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Keep the point between you and the trouble. Give yourself room to step back. We'll practice until your feet remember it.

quests.name: Beyond the Point
quests.lore: An orc raiding party near Underleaf has stripped the west patrol's spare equipment. Tobin Reed needs it back before he sends another pair of guards down that road.
quests.completionMessage: Keep the point between you and the trouble. Give yourself room to step back.

quests.name: Nothing Gets Through
quests.lore: A slide shut the gold mine out in the Wastelands. The only man still trying to open it is working with tools that gave up on him years ago.

quests.name: The Matriarch
quests.lore: The flock that came down to Gregor's road answers to one bird on the Willow Downs cliff. Ossa wants her taken off it before the whole flock settles on Wispmeyer for good.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That's my chain. He's bent three of the links, but it'll hold a stake.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I'll have traps back in the water by the next tide. The whole village eats better for this. Take something from the chest. The fish market chipped in.

quests.name: Gullet
quests.lore: Hill giant adolescents wade the shallows east of Windthorne and smash the village's fish traps. The biggest of them, Gullet, leads them there.
quests.completionMessage: I'll have traps back in the water by the next tide. The whole village eats better for this. Take something from the chest. The fish market chipped in.

quests.name: A Road Nobody Rides
quests.lore: Wispmeyer's supply wagons stopped coming after the last driver came back with the canvas cut open and wouldn't say why. Gregor Sr. wants the down road ridden and whatever's on it dealt with.

quests.name: The White Mare
quests.lore: A white mare has run loose on the down since the winter she came through Wispmeyer wearing a saddle and no rider. The Stablemaster wants her in his paddock before the harpies bring her down.
